query.comment: the handover machinery never gets stuck
the T304 race has at most one outcome: success or failure
RRCReestablishmentRequest is only sent after the handover failure is stored in VarRLF-Report, and carries cause handoverFailure (5.3.7.4)

query.formula: A[] (hf_report == 1 imply (UE.RES or UE.REQ or UE.REEST or UE.IDLE))
query.comment: after a failed handover the UE is inside the re-establishment chain
every handover attempt ends in a terminal outcome: connected on target, re-established, or RRC_IDLE
T304 always resolves: the target is reached or the sync failure is declared
every declared handover failure ends in re-establishment or RRC_IDLE
T311 always resolves: a cell is found and T301 starts, or the UE goes idle
T301 always resolves: re-established or RRC_IDLE
a successful handover within T304 is reachable
T304 expiry with the failure stored in VarRLF-Report is reachable
recovery by re-establishment after a failed handover is reachable
